sections.text: You're in. See you Sat 14 Nov.
Weekend MVP Build-Along · Build it Saturday, ship it Sunday.
15:00–17:00 GMT on Zoom. Your receipt is on its way from Stripe. The Zoom link and a reminder come by email before the session.

Add it to your calendar. The confirmation email has the invite.Open the Ship Sheet when it arrives and make your own copy.Set up a free account on the tool named in your prep email and pick an idea, or a couple to choose from. Browse free ideas.

Can't make it live? You'll get the replay, and it doesn't expire. Changed your mind? Full refund within 30 days of purchase, no reason needed. Just email us. A refund ends your replay access. Read the refund policy.
